gcp-professional-cloud-architect.title: Professional Cloud Architect
gcp-professional-cloud-architect.description: Design, develop, and manage robust, secure, scalable, efficient, cost-effective, highly available, and flexible Google Cloud solutions that drive business objectives.

gcp-professional-cloud-developer.title: Professional Cloud Developer
gcp-professional-cloud-developer.description: Build and configure scalable, secure cloud-native applications using Google-recommended tools, generative AI APIs, and modern application development practices.

gcp-professional-data-engineer.title: Professional Data Engineer
gcp-professional-data-engineer.description: Design, build, deploy, monitor, maintain, optimize, and secure data processing and storage workloads that support data-driven decisions.

gcp-professional-cloud-database-engineer.title: Professional Cloud Database Engineer
gcp-professional-cloud-database-engineer.description: Design, create, manage, migrate, scale, and troubleshoot Google Cloud databases for resilient and cost-effective application data platforms.

gcp-professional-machine-learning-engine.title: Professional Machine Learning Engineer
gcp-professional-machine-learning-engine.description: Build, evaluate, productionize, optimize, automate, and monitor conventional and generative AI solutions on Google Cloud.

gcp-professional-cloud-security-engineer.title: Professional Cloud Security Engineer
gcp-professional-cloud-security-engineer.description: Design and implement secure Google Cloud workloads across identity, network boundaries, data protection, security operations, AI security, supply chain, and compliance.

gcp-professional-cloud-devops-engineer.title: Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer
gcp-professional-cloud-devops-engineer.description: Implement delivery, SRE, observability, troubleshooting, and FinOps practices that balance software delivery speed with production reliability.

gcp-professional-cloud-network-engineer.title: Professional Cloud Network Engineer
gcp-professional-cloud-network-engineer.description: Design, implement, secure, monitor, and troubleshoot Google Cloud VPC, hybrid, multicloud, GKE, load-balancing, DNS, routing, and connectivity architectures.

gcp-professional-agentic-architect.title: Professional Agentic Architect
gcp-professional-agentic-architect.description: Design and manage autonomous AI-driven agentic workflows with low-code tools, custom agents, enterprise retrieval, multiagent orchestration, evaluation, deployment, and governance.

gcp-professional-security-operations-eng.title: Professional Security Operations Engineer
gcp-professional-security-operations-eng.description: Detect, hunt, investigate, respond to, and report on security threats using Google Security Operations, Security Command Center, threat intelligence, detection engineering, and SOAR workflows.

gcp-associate-cloud-engineer.title: Associate Cloud Engineer
gcp-associate-cloud-engineer.description: Deploy, secure, operate, monitor, and scale Google Cloud applications, services, infrastructure, data, networking, and access controls using common platform tooling.

gcp-associate-data-practitioner.title: Associate Data Practitioner
gcp-associate-data-practitioner.description: Prepare, ingest, analyze, visualize, orchestrate, secure, and govern data using Google Cloud data and analytics services.

gcp-associate-google-workspace-administr.title: Associate Google Workspace Administrator
gcp-associate-google-workspace-administr.description: Administer Google Workspace identities, core collaboration services, governance, security, endpoints, reporting, and troubleshooting for day-to-day operations.

gcp-generative-ai-leader.title: Generative AI Leader
gcp-generative-ai-leader.description: Understand Google Cloud generative AI concepts, offerings, model-improvement techniques, secure and responsible AI, and business strategies for transformational gen AI adoption.

gcp-cloud-digital-leader.title: Cloud Digital Leader
gcp-cloud-digital-leader.description: Explain how Google Cloud supports digital transformation across data, AI, infrastructure, application modernization, security, operations, and cost control.

aws-advanced-networking-specialty.title: AWS Certified Advanced Networking – Specialty
aws-advanced-networking-specialty.description: Study hybrid connectivity, global routing, multi-account and multi-Region networking, network security, observability, automation, and AWS networking services using the official ANS-C01 scope.
